text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's gathered for the final<n>race of the Triple
Tiara, the Shuka<n>Sho. It won't be long till this
decisive<n>race begins, folks!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
I've got my handkerchief and tissues<n>ready, so
I'm all set! I'm rooting for<n>ya, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Please, oh, please! I hope I get to see<n>Dober smile
that smile again!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is so focused that she<n>doesn't even
react to the sound of<n>the roaring crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Never mind. I just wanted to get you<n>back since
you're always asking me<n>the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. You always ask me that,<n>so I wanted
to tease you a bit to get<n>you back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I answer her question frankly. As her<n>trainer, there
hasn't been a single<n>time I wasn't nervous while
seeing<n>her off for a race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... So you get nervous too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So you've been feeling nervous<n>for me all this
time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've always been so caught up<n>with myself
that I never noticed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Too bad for you, I'm not going to give<n>you a chance
to be nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you and everyone else how<n>much I've
grown throughout the<n>Triple Tiara.
